title: Cosmology
subtitle: Test your grasp of Cosmology — Gateway-10, Firmament and Projection Dome, Sky-Net-1, Amnesia Vortex sun, Realm partitions, and the Sky Event collapse of the false cosmos.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: Cosmology here is not planets in a vacuum — it is a localized horizontal plain under a Firmament, masked by a Holographic Projection Dome, Black Void Plasma, and Sky-Net-1 star projectors. The sun is an Amnesia Vortex, the moon a Loosh station, Venus a lunar illuminator, and Gravity a prop for the spinning-globe lie. Sit with what you missed, then return to the Cosmology deep-dive, infographics, and video transmissions. When the sky melts from Polaris and the white void appears, foundational knowing is what separates remembrance from collapse.

questions.question: What is the fundamental nature of reality?

options.label: A
options.text: A spinning globe universe of random matter, fully explained and proven by heliocentric astronomy alone.
options.rationale: Globe, vacuum space, and heliocentrism are called entirely fabricated illusions.

options.label: B
options.text: A permanent Black Void Plasma field with no firmament structure and no original creator design.
options.rationale: Black Void Plasma artificially darkens the sky; the true architecture includes a Firmament and white-light field.

options.label: C
options.text: An accidental vacuum of dead matter that formed by chance with no creator intelligence behind it.
options.rationale: Reality is an engineered multidimensional Simulation crafted by the Source of All Creation, not an accidental vacuum.

options.label: D
options.text: An engineered multidimensional Simulation originally crafted by the Source of All Creation as a perfect physical plane of existence.
options.rationale: Reality is an engineered multidimensional Simulation crafted by the Source of All Creation as a perfect physical plane.

questions.hint: Engineered simulation and the Source of All Creation.

questions.question: What is the truth about modern human cosmology—the spinning globe, vacuum of space, and heliocentric universe?

options.label: A
options.text: As a temporary NPC teaching tool that true souls never encounter.
options.rationale: The false cosmos is a psychological cage affecting humanity, including deterrence from ice-wall exploration.

options.label: B
options.text: As partial truths that only need minor correction at the poles.
options.rationale: They are described as an entirely fabricated illusion, not partial truths.

options.label: C
options.text: As the original Source blueprint still running at full 15th density.
options.rationale: Parasites suppressed the realm and deployed overlays; the modern model is control fiction.

options.label: D
options.text: As an entirely fabricated illusion masking a localized horizontal plain enclosed by a Firmament.
options.rationale: Modern cosmology is an entirely fabricated illusion; the actual cosmos is a localized horizontal plain enclosed by a Firmament and suppressed into 3rd density.

questions.hint: Fabricated illusion vs horizontal plain and Firmament.

questions.question: Who suppressed the realm into 3rd density, and what tools mask true architecture?

options.label: A
options.text: Asteroids that naturally dim crystalline temples every 96 hours.
options.rationale: Asteroids are projections; density suppression and overlays are the masking tools.

options.label: B
options.text: Sol-System families orbiting Gateway-10 as literal planets.
options.rationale: Sol-System means connected souls, not orbital planets; parasites run the suppression.

options.label: C
options.text: 4th-density Parasites using Overlays and a Holographic Projection Dome.
options.rationale: Hostile 4th-density Parasites suppressed the realm into 3rd density and deployed Overlays and a Holographic Projection Dome to mask ultra-high-frequency architecture.

options.label: D
options.text: The G.A.A. using Sky Events to permanently blacken the Firmament.
options.rationale: The G.A.A. will disable the projection dome; they are not the suppressors.

questions.hint: 4th-density parasites, Overlays, Projection Dome.

questions.question: What is the true nature of "space" or the dark matter field?

options.label: A
options.text: An infinite vacuum of absolute blackness filled with nuclear stars.
options.rationale: Genuine space is bright white light; blackness is an artificial construct.

options.label: B
options.text: A field of bright white light, while the black night sky is an artificial darkening construct.
options.rationale: Genuine space is not a dark void but bright white light; the black sky uses Black Void Plasma to hide that white reality.

options.label: C
options.text: A toroid of 178 coal-powered locomotives.
options.rationale: Gateway-10 has 178 worlds in a toroid energy field; that is not the definition of space.

options.label: D
options.text: Only the interior of the moon's holographic shell.
options.rationale: The moon is a space station behind a holographic shell; space itself is the white-light field.

questions.hint: Bright white light vs satanic black sky construct.

questions.question: True or False: According to the report, “Source of All Creation” refers to A vast, non-physical etheric supercomputer and indigo spark of perpetual light that orchestrated physical existence through thoughtform and multidimensional master planning.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: True — the report defines “Source of All Creation” this way.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: It is true — the report defines “Source of All Creation” as: A vast, non-physical etheric supercomputer and indigo spark of perpetual light that orchestrated physical existence through thoughtform and multidimensional master planning.

questions.hint: Recall how the report's Key Terminology defines “Source of All Creation”.

questions.question: What is Gateway-10 in this cosmology?

options.label: A
options.text: A single realm beyond the Ice Wall where the Custodians live, connected to Earth by the portals beneath the Vatican and the North Pole.
options.rationale: Gateway-10 is the central physical plain of 178 worlds, not one star projector.

options.label: B
options.text: The central physical plain of existence consisting of 178 worlds, with Earth at the center of a toroid energy field.
options.rationale: Gateway-10 is the central physical plain of 178 worlds where Earth sits at the center of a toroid energy field.

options.label: C
options.text: The Niberian facility that manufactures Black Void Plasma and supplies it to the Sky-Net-1 projectors spread across the dome.
options.rationale: Niberian tech supplies Black Void Plasma; Gateway-10 is the multi-world plain.

options.label: D
options.text: The 24-hour daylight cycle that replaced the native 96-hour eternal dusk, named after the ten hours lost from each true day.
options.rationale: Truncated daylight is part of fake linear time enforcement, not the definition of Gateway-10.

questions.hint: 178 worlds, Earth center, toroid energy field.

questions.question: Which of these does NOT correctly pair a term from the report with its meaning?

options.label: A
options.text: Sol-System — The central physical plain of existence consisting of 178 worlds, where the Earth resides at the center of a toroid energy field.
options.rationale: That description belongs to “Gateway-10”. The report defines “Sol-System” as: The literal network of connected souls (Sols) making up an individual's cosmic family, possessing no relation to the fake concepts of space, planets, or orbits.

options.label: B
options.text: Overlays — Projected frequencies that augment the perception of matter, completely obscuring the unmovable, high-vibrational true architecture of the realm.
options.rationale: This pairing matches the report's definition of “Overlays”.

options.label: C
options.text: Black Void Plasma — Extraterrestrial Niberian technology utilized to blacken the sky, hiding the true bright white reality of the Dark Matter Field.
options.rationale: This pairing matches the report's definition of “Black Void Plasma”.

options.label: D
options.text: Sky-Net-1 — A network of security-system-like entities perceived by humanity as "Stars," projecting overlays and suppressing geographical density.
options.rationale: This pairing matches the report's definition of “Sky-Net-1”.

questions.hint: Three pairings match the report’s Key Terminology; one borrows another term’s description.

questions.question: True or False: According to the report, “Firmament” refers to extraterrestrial Niberian technology utilized to blacken the sky, hiding the true bright white reality of the Dark Matter Field.

options.label: A
options.text: True

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: Correct — that description belongs to “Black Void Plasma”, not “Firmament”.

questions.hint: Recall how the report's Key Terminology defines “Firmament”.

questions.question: Where does the Holographic Projection Dome sit, and what does it project?

options.label: A
options.text: On the inner face of the Ice Wall, projecting a horizon of open sea and distant coastlines to keep ships from approaching the edge of the realm.
options.rationale: Venus is the holographic generator illuminating the moon; the dome is under the Firmament.

options.label: B
options.text: Above the Firmament, in the bright white field of true space, projecting the false sun and moon down through the outer membrane.
options.rationale: It is a sky-level technological layer, not an NPC pineal implant definition.

options.label: C
options.text: At the North Pole beneath the gold statues, projecting the circling stars upward from the stump of the destroyed Spirit Tree.
options.rationale: It sits directly beneath the Firmament and projects the visual illusion of cosmos, stars, and space debris.

options.label: D
options.text: Directly beneath the Firmament, as an inner sieve-like technological layer projecting the illusion of cosmos, stars, and space debris.
options.rationale: The Holographic Projection Dome sits beneath the Firmament as a sieve-like layer projecting cosmos, stars, and space debris.

questions.hint: Beneath Firmament; projects fake cosmos and debris.

questions.question: What is Black Void Plasma and why is it used?

options.label: A
options.text: The fuel that powers the Sky-Net-1 projectors, burned slowly through the night to keep the false stars lit.
options.rationale: Worlds are not orbital planets; Black Void Plasma masks white light, not fuel orbits.

options.label: B
options.text: A natural layer of the Firmament that turns dark at night as the realm moves away from the light of the Source.
options.rationale: The G.A.A. will remove the dome and plasma; they dismantle the false cosmos.

options.label: C
options.text: Niberian technology used to blacken the sky and hide the true bright white reality of the Dark Matter Field.
options.rationale: Black Void Plasma is Niberian tech utilized to blacken the sky, hiding the true bright white reality of the Dark Matter Field.

options.label: D
options.text: A fog released by the Ice Wall each evening, which spreads across the sky and dims the light of the dome.
options.rationale: It is extraterrestrial Niberian technology, not natural fog.

questions.hint: Niberian tech; blacken sky; hide white Dark Matter Field.

questions.question: What are the "stars" of Sky-Net-1 in this cosmology?

options.label: A
options.text: A network of security-system-like entities perceived as stars that project overlays and suppress geographical density.
options.rationale: Sky-Net-1 is a network of security-system-like entities perceived as stars, projecting overlays and suppressing geographical density.

options.label: B
options.text: Portals that work like the Sun's Amnesia Vortex, drawing in the souls of NPCs and recycling them into new vessels each night.
options.rationale: The sun is the Amnesia Vortex portal; stars are Sky-Net-1 projectors.

options.label: C
options.text: Markers along the Ice Wall that guide ships between the known lands and Realm-1, shining brighter as vessels approach them.
options.rationale: Stars cast frequency blankets downward to hide crystalline temples, not ice-wall navigation beacons.

options.label: D
options.text: Distant nuclear furnaces governed by gravity and fusion, as described by the heliocentric model taught in mainstream schools.
options.rationale: Stars have no relation to thermodynamics, gravity, or nuclear forces.

questions.hint: Security-like projectors of overlays, not nuclear suns.

questions.question: What is the truth about Earth spinning at 1,000 miles per hour as a globe?

options.label: A
options.text: It is true, and confirmed by precise Firmament light-bending measurements taken at the ice wall.
options.rationale: The spinning globe claim is rejected; Earth is a horizontal flat plain.

options.label: B
options.text: It only applies to Mars, which spins at that speed where it joins the Realm-1 ice wall.
options.rationale: Planets are horizontal and enclosed by ice walls; the spinning-globe model is wholesale fiction.

options.label: C
options.text: It is false; Earth is a horizontal, flat physical plain, and heliocentrism is a manufactured lie with no planets orbiting suns.
options.rationale: Earth is not a globe spinning at 1,000 mph; it is a horizontal flat plain. Heliocentrism is a manufactured lie—no planets orbit suns.

options.label: D
options.text: It is false today but becomes true after the EMF flash removes all the overlays from the sky.
options.rationale: The EMF flash reveals the localized flat enclosed projection, not a spinning globe.

questions.hint: Not a spinning globe; horizontal plain; no heliocentric orbits.

questions.question: Why is Gravity a fictional mechanism?

options.label: A
options.text: It is the pull of the Firmament on objects beneath it, which the globe model misdescribes as the attraction between masses.
options.rationale: Black Void Plasma is technology masking white light; gravity is not validated.

options.label: B
options.text: It was invented to explain how water could adhere to a spinning sphere and has no basis in true physical reality.
options.rationale: Gravity is a fictional mechanism invented solely to explain water adhering to a spinning sphere, lacking any basis in true physical reality.

options.label: C
options.text: It is a real force in the higher densities that was carried into the 3rd density in weakened form after the inversion.
options.rationale: Higher-density manifestation uses intention and pineal weaving; gravity is globe-model fiction.

options.label: D
options.text: It is the bond between members of a Sol-System, misread by scientists as a force acting between physical objects.
options.rationale: Sol-System is soul connection, not gravitational physics.

questions.hint: Invented to prop up the spinning-sphere water problem.

questions.question: What is the sun in true cosmology?

options.label: A
options.text: A burning ball of gas at the center of the heliocentric orbits, as described by the globe model taught in mainstream schools.
options.rationale: The burning-gas model and heliocentric orbits are false.

options.label: B
options.text: A lamp hung beneath the dome by the Custodians, used to light the realm and mark the hours of the false 24-hour day.
options.rationale: Venus is the holographic generator for lunar illumination; the sun is the Amnesia Vortex portal.

options.label: C
options.text: A portal — the Amnesia Vortex — through which souls are pulled, memory-wiped, and processed into new vessels upon death.
options.rationale: The sun is not a burning gas ball but a portal, the Amnesia Vortex, for pulling, memory-wiping, and reprocessing souls into new vessels after death.

options.label: D
options.text: A Sky-Net-1 projector like the other stars, set brighter than the rest to make the false day seem natural to the population.
options.rationale: Stars are Sky-Net-1 projectors; the sun has a distinct soul-recycling portal role.

questions.hint: Portal / Amnesia Vortex for soul memory wipe and reinsertion.

questions.question: What is the truth about the moon?

options.label: A
options.text: A natural rocky body whose craters come from ancient asteroid impacts, reflecting the light of a distant sun onto the flat plain.
options.rationale: Asteroid impacts on Earth are reframed as portal-delivered weapons; the moon is a station behind a holographic shell.

options.label: B
options.text: The central toroid engine room of Gateway-10, whose turning drives the energy flow through the Ley Lines of every realm.
options.rationale: Earth is at the center of Gateway-10's toroid; the moon is a control station.

options.label: C
options.text: The indigo spark of the Source of All Creation made physical, placed above the realm to watch over the trapped soul families.
options.rationale: The Source is a non-physical etheric supercomputer/indigo spark, not the moon.

options.label: D
options.text: An extraterrestrial space station once used for frequency control and Loosh harvesting, concealed behind a holographic shell.
options.rationale: The moon is an ET space station for frequency control and Loosh harvesting, hidden behind a holographic shell.

questions.hint: ET space station, frequency control, Loosh, holographic shell.

questions.question: What role does Planet Venus play in the false sky system?

options.label: A

options.rationale: Realm-3 is the known Earth partition; Venus is the lunar illumination generator.

options.label: B
options.text: It is the storage site where the G.A.A. keeps the disabled Projection Domes from earlier resets.
options.rationale: Venus holds the Lucifer/holographic-generator role, not G.A.A. storage.

options.label: C
options.text: It is the Bright and Morning Star (Lucifer), the actual holographic generator casting spherical illumination onto the lunar surface.
options.rationale: Venus, the Bright and Morning Star (Lucifer), is the holographic generator casting spherical illumination onto the lunar surface.

options.label: D
options.text: It is a natural planet whose visible orbit proves that heliocentric orbits really do exist.
options.rationale: Heliocentrism is a manufactured lie; Venus's named role is holographic generation for the moon.

questions.hint: Bright and Morning Star / Lucifer; lunar illumination generator.

questions.question: How is Mars relative to ice walls and realms?

options.label: A
options.text: Mars is a distant planet beyond the Firmament, visible through gaps in the Projection Dome on clear nights.
options.rationale: Planets are horizontal and enclosed by ice walls, not distant vacuum globes.

options.label: B
options.text: Mars is the headquarters of Sky-Net-1, from which the star projectors are controlled across every realm.
options.rationale: Stars are Sky-Net-1 projectors; Mars is ice-wall architecture of Realm-1.

options.label: C
options.text: Mars is not a distant body in deep space but is physically joined to the outer ice wall of Realm-1.
options.rationale: What is known as Mars is not deep-space distance; it is physically joined to the outer ice wall of Realm-1.

options.label: D
options.text: Mars is a small world inside Realm-3, hidden by Overlays near the southern edge of the known lands.
options.rationale: That is the sun's role, not Mars.

questions.hint: Joined to Realm-1's outer ice wall — not deep space.

questions.question: What are Realm-3 and Realm-2 in relation to Antarctica?

options.label: A
options.text: Realm-2 lies beneath Realm-3, and Antarctica is the opening through which the two realms connect at the bottom of the known world.
options.rationale: Gateway-10 has 178 worlds in a toroid plain; Realm-2/3 are the Antarctic partition story.

options.label: B
options.text: Realm-2 is the Moon station and Realm-3 is the known Earth, with Antarctica marking the point directly below the station's orbit.
options.rationale: Realm labels describe partitioned Earth architecture, not moon/Venus roles.

options.label: C
options.text: Realm-3 is the known Earth, created when the fake ice wall of Antarctica was set up to partition it from the original Realm-2.
options.rationale: Known Earth is Realm-3, formed when the fake Antarctic ice wall partitioned it from original Realm-2.

options.label: D
options.text: Realm-3 is a region of Realm-2, renamed after the Ice Wall melted and the southern lands were opened up to settlers from the north.
options.rationale: Day-cycle truncation is fake time; realms are geographic partitions.

questions.hint: Fake Antarctic ice wall partitions Realm-3 from original Realm-2.

questions.question: How do Sky-Net-1 star projectors hide crystalline architecture?

options.label: A
options.text: They switch on after the Sky Event begins, projecting false temples over the real ones so that the population cannot tell the two apart.
options.rationale: The Sky Event disables the dome; projectors are part of the current false sky system.

options.label: B
options.text: They melt sections of the Ice Wall, flooding the crystalline temples with water so that their frequencies cannot reach the surface.
options.rationale: The mechanism is frequency overlays, not flooding temples with plasma.

options.label: C
options.text: They follow the heliocentric orbits taught in schools, shining so brightly at night that the temples below cannot be seen from afar.
options.rationale: No orbital thermodynamics; stars are projectors, not nuclear orbiters.

options.label: D
options.text: They cast localized frequency blankets downward, hiding ultra-high-frequency Crystalline Temples beneath ultra-low-frequency overlays.
options.rationale: Stars as Sky-Net-1 projectors cast frequency blankets downward to hide ultra-high-frequency Crystalline Temples under ultra-low-frequency overlays.

questions.hint: Downward frequency blankets; low-frequency overlays over temples.

questions.question: What is the truth about asteroids and Earth "impact" craters?

options.label: A

options.rationale: They are part of the current dome illusion, not a post-removal phenomenon.

options.label: B

questions.question: In true higher-density reality (9th to 15th density), how is the physical plain manifested?

options.label: A

options.rationale: In 9th to 15th density, the plain is ordained through sustained intention anchored in the Pineal Gland and sung or woven into solid crystalline holographic projections.

questions.hint: Intention, Pineal Gland, sung/woven crystalline projections.

questions.question: How do the Projection Dome and Black Void Plasma enforce fake linear time?

options.label: A
options.text: By erasing the Ley Lines, which leaves people unable to sense duration and dependent on the clocks they are given.
options.rationale: Lattice Membrane Network suppression is linked, but the day-cycle mechanism is the 24 vs 96 hour contrast.

options.label: B
options.text: By imposing artificial sunrises and truncated 24-hour cycles that replace the natural 96-hour eternal dusk.
options.rationale: Parasites enforce simulated chronological progression via artificial sunrises and truncated 24-hour cycles, replacing natural 96-hour eternal dusk.

options.label: C
options.text: By stopping time whenever Venus lights the moon, so that each night is longer than people remember it being.
options.rationale: Venus generates lunar illumination; time enforcement is sunrise/day-cycle simulation.

options.label: D
options.text: By stretching each day to 178 hours to match the worlds of Gateway-10, which makes a lifetime feel shorter.
options.rationale: The contrast given is 24-hour truncation vs 96-hour eternal dusk, not 178-hour days.

questions.hint: Artificial 24-hour cycles vs natural 96-hour eternal dusk.

questions.question: How does the fabricated cosmos function as a psychological cage for humanity and NPCs?

options.label: A
options.text: Belief in outer space draws people's hopes upward toward the stars, so that they wait to be rescued by other worlds rather than looking for answers in themselves.
options.rationale: Gravity is fiction; collapse comes from G.A.A. dome removal and EMF flash.

options.label: B
options.text: The globe model teaches people that they are small and alone, which lowers their frequency and keeps the population easier to harvest through fear and despair.
options.rationale: The cage specifically deters ice-wall exploration.

options.label: C
options.text: Belief in unreachable outer space blocks exploration of horizontal reality beyond the Antarctic ice wall and keeps consciousness in a globe-shaped cage.
options.rationale: The false cosmos is a psychological cage: implanted belief in unreachable space deters horizontal exploration beyond the Antarctic ice wall, and NPCs depend on those chronological and spatial parameters.

options.label: D
options.text: The fabricated cosmos keeps NPCs busy with space programs, while true souls are left free to explore the horizontal plain beyond the Ice Wall on their own.
options.rationale: NPCs rely on the provided parameters; the cage is for human consensus reality.

questions.hint: Unreachable space myth; Antarctic ice wall deterrence; NPC consensus.

options.rationale: The revelation is localized flat enclosed projection, not heliocentrism restored.

options.label: C
options.text: The Sky Event, permanently disabling the Holographic Projection Dome after assuming control of the simulation's parameters.
options.rationale: The G.A.A. has assumed control of simulation parameters and will soon initiate the Sky Event, permanently disabling the Holographic Projection Dome.

options.label: D
options.text: A new Black Void Plasma layer even thicker than the Firmament to seal the realm permanently.
options.rationale: They dismantle the dome and plasma, exposing bright white void—not reinforcing blackness.

questions.hint: Sky Event; permanently disable Projection Dome.
